visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female singer with short, curly brown hair wears a vibrant pink sleeveless button-up shirt. She stands in a white studio-like environment, holding a wired microphone close to her mouth, singing with an emotional, focused expression. To her left, a wooden shelf holds a game box labeled 'MONOPOLY'. (2) The scene cuts to an interview setting where the same woman is seated on a grey fabric couch next to a man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a blue denim shirt. They are engaged in an animated conversation with active hand gestures and laughter. (3) Intercut archival footage displays a younger version of the woman with straight, dark hair in various moody settings, including an indoor space with a fireplace and an outdoor balcony overlooking a cityscape with an Eiffel Tower replica. (4) Back in the contemporary setting, the woman is seen laughing and jokingly kneeling on the floor in front of the man on the couch. (5) The woman returns to the microphone, singing passionately. (6) The final shot shows the woman and the man holding up envelopes while looking at each other, with significant graphic text overlays appearing above and below them.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Nostalgic Interview -> Emotional Reconnection -> Announcement/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to reconnect former singer Alice Hong (洪愛莉) with her audience after a 24-year hiatus. It uses a blend of contemporary interview footage and archival clips to tell her story of leaving the music industry and her current feelings, culminating in the announcement of a 24th-anniversary online music concert.
